summary: IperionX Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing a corporate investor presentation posted on its website on April 27, 2026. This is a routine disclosure of an ordinary investor relations communication with no terms, transaction, or special situation event specified. No stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural details are provided. The filing is a standard periodic report from a foreign private issuer. There is no event to monitor or risk-arb angle as this filing does not involve a merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change.
